name: Gyms and fitness studios

problems.words: Renewals expire and nobody calls the member
quick_ideas: List the memberships ending this month, so you know who to contact
Have the front desk reach those members once before expiry, since renewing is easier than winning them back.

workzap_build.text: a member register that sends renewal reminders on WhatsApp automatically before expiry and tracks who renewed.

problems.ask_first: Roughly how many active members do you have?
problems.free_stops: Reminder timing and renewal tracking are in the solution document.

problems.words: January joiners stop coming by March and never renew
quick_ideas: Find members who haven't visited in a while from your entry records, since they're the ones about to leave
Have a trainer check in with them once, because a personal call means more than an offer.

workzap_build.text: a churn watch listing members who haven't visited for a set number of days, refreshed daily for a call.

problems.ask_first: How do members get in, card, register or turnstile?
problems.free_stops: The inactivity rules and call list flow stay for the solution document.

problems.words: Front desk lets in people whose membership has expired
quick_ideas: Check this week's entries against the expiry list once, to see how often it happens
Make the expiry check part of every entry, so it doesn't depend on memory.

workzap_build.text: an access check linking the turnstile or desk to membership status, flagging expired entries automatically.

problems.ask_first: Does your gym software connect to the turnstile?
problems.free_stops: How access and membership data connect is in the solution document.

quick_ideas: Make sure all PT is sold and paid at the desk, so private deals stand out
Compare PT sessions seen on the floor with sessions paid, to see whether there's a gap.

workzap_build.text: a PT session log with client sign-off, matched to paid packs every day.

problems.free_stops: Sign-off method and matching rules stay for the solution document.

problems.words: PT commission causes arguments every month
quick_ideas: Write down the commission rule each trainer is on, so there's one version
Share each trainer's session count before payday, so disputes come up early.

workzap_build.text: automatic monthly commission per trainer from signed-off sessions.

problems.ask_first: Are trainers salaried, on commission or freelance?
problems.free_stops: Commission logic and statement layout go in the solution document.

problems.words: Machines are out of order for weeks
quick_ideas: List every broken machine with the date it broke, so downtime is visible
Agree a fix date with your technician, so repairs have a deadline.

workzap_build.text: an equipment log with downtime days per machine and repair status.

problems.free_stops: Ticket flow and downtime reporting are in the solution document.

problems.words: Leads from free trials aren't followed up
quick_ideas: Keep one list of this month's trial users who agreed to be contacted, so none slip
Have one person follow up each once, since trials go cold quickly.

workzap_build.text: a trial-to-member tracker with automatic follow-up reminders and conversion counts.

problems.ask_first: Where do most enquiries come from?
problems.free_stops: Follow-up timing and lead flow stay for the solution document.

problems.words: Fees in cash and transfer and I can't reconcile them
quick_ideas: Match this month's payments to members once, to see what's unaccounted for
Record the payment method for every fee taken, so transfers can be traced.

workzap_build.text: cash, card and transfers matched to members daily, with gaps flagged.

problems.free_stops: Matching rules are in the solution document.

problems.words: Class bookings via WhatsApp lead to overbooked classes
quick_ideas: Keep each class's list in one place with a set limit, so it can't be overbooked
Make one person own class bookings, so WhatsApp promises don't clash.

workzap_build.text: a class schedule with WhatsApp booking, capacity limits and a waitlist.

problems.ask_first: How many classes run a week?
problems.free_stops: Booking flow and waitlist rules go in the solution document.

quick_ideas: Agree the same few numbers from each branch, so you compare like with like
Put one month side by side, to see which branch needs attention.

workzap_build.text: a morning read per branch: active members, new joins, renewals, churn, revenue.

problems.ask_first: How many branches do you run?
problems.free_stops: Which numbers and their sources are in the solution document.

never_say: Fitness, diet, supplement, steroid or injury advice.
Collecting members' health data, weights, measurements, photos or biometrics.
Any recording in changing rooms or ladies-only areas.
Help selling unregistered or prohibited supplements.
Consumer-law advice on cancellations; collapse or serious injury means emergency services first.

sample_reply.person: Renewals are a mess, memberships expire and nobody calls anyone. Can you suggest a fix?
sample_reply.pi: Yes, this is very fixable. 1) List the memberships ending this month, so you know exactly who to contact. 2) Have the front desk reach each of those members once before their plan ends. Workzap can do this automatically for you: renewal reminders sent on WhatsApp before every expiry, with a daily view of who renewed and who didn't. Shall I prepare a solution document and quote for you? You can say no.
